fields.label: Marketing version
fields.requiredWhen: Both values are required for every edit or creation.
fields.what: The human-readable release version stored under the saved name key.
fields.why: Keeps release consumers on one explicit version spelling.
fields.where: Dashboard, after Open saved version. The source and key come only from saved Settings.
fields.format: 1-64 ASCII characters in shared dotted numeric form. Saved iOS policy requires two or three numeric components. Example: 1.2.3.
fields.failure: Format validity is not Store approval, artifact agreement or provenance. Unsupported source grammar is refused, not repaired.

fields.label: Build number
fields.requiredWhen: Both values are required for every edit or creation.
fields.what: The build identifier stored as a string under the saved build key.
fields.why: Makes the shared positive integer policy explicit without silently converting or incrementing it.
fields.where: The same saved version source. Choose the intended value; the app never auto-bumps.
fields.format: Canonical decimal digits from 1 through 2100000000, at most 10 bytes. No spaces, signs or leading zeros. Example: 42.
fields.failure: A valid number is not evidence of Store monotonicity. Existing unambiguous invalid values may be opened so you can correct them.

actions.label: Open saved version
actions.what: Load the two saved values through the original finite editor without writing.
actions.why: Separates ordinary Read from a deliberate create/edit session.
actions.where: Dashboard. Save missing or invalid configuration in Settings first.
actions.format: Only the native-selected project ID is supplied. Source, keys, iOS policy and absence are derived from saved configuration.
actions.failure: Missing ignore coverage needs the normal Settings Save review. Empty, malformed, unreadable or unsafe files are not Create permission.

actions.label: Validate and review values
actions.what: Ask the core to validate both exact strings and freeze one complete before/after review.
actions.why: Binds the proposal to the original saved config, ignore proof and selected file.
actions.where: Edit the two fields, then choose Validate and review.
actions.format: Existing files change only the two selected inner spans. Create emits two KEY=VALUE lines, UTF-8/LF, with a final newline.
actions.failure: A changed baseline refuses. Reopening carries the old baseline; it is not automatic rebase. Invalid Prepare is consumed once.

actions.label: Confirm local version save
actions.what: Submit only the exact original one-use plan after acknowledgement and typed SAVE.
actions.why: Prevents incidental text editing from changing release inputs.
actions.where: The full native review, including source, hashes, modes, directories and line-ending facts.
actions.format: Edit preserves unrelated bytes and mode. Create requests mode 0644 and parent modes 0755, subject to native umask.
actions.failure: No build, native-project rewrite, Git/index operation or Store request is included. Uncertainty preserves the original owner and blocks retry.

actions.label: Reload saved values
actions.what: Explicitly discard the current value draft and load a fresh original after settlement.
actions.why: Makes reconciliation intentional instead of silently replacing your baseline.
actions.where: Close the original session, then confirm Reload saved values and discard draft.
actions.format: Confirmation is tied to the displayed project and exact draft revision.
actions.failure: A failed or late reload does not erase the old draft. Recovery-required or unknown settlement cannot be bypassed.

actions.label: Discard value changes
actions.what: Reset the local two-value draft to its retained original values.
actions.why: Keeps Close editor separate from losing work.
actions.where: After the original owner settles, confirm Discard value changes.
actions.format: In-memory only. No values or source text are persisted in app storage, logs or telemetry.
actions.failure: Discard does not reread, rebase, recover or delete any file. Previously submitted outcomes stay visible.
